_comment: Direction pack: the standing order. A partner naming this pack buys every theme below under the shipped agreement. Canonical prose for what these numbers mean: docs/trajectory-packs/PACK-SPEC.md. Provenance of each number: the `_provenance` block.

_provenance.min_assistant_turns: reference funnel criteria ①: 'assistant 轮<5' removed
_provenance.dedup_threshold: reference funnel: 'near-duplicate template clusters removed'; the Jaccard value is this repository's, not the reference's
_provenance.max_tool_ratio: DECISION, not from the reference: the reference removed 'coding tools or coding agent scaffold' by an upstream classifier that no longer exists in this path. 0.15 is the funnel's existing report preset, kept so non-coding means prose-dominant.
_provenance.min_user_msg_chars / max_first_msg_chars: this repository's existing L4 length stage; the reference has no equivalent and its effect here must be measured, not assumed
_provenance.topic_match: 'any' because the reference counts a session under every theme it satisfies (its coverage table sums past 10)
